parameters.command: cd /Users/bara080/bara/zinga-os && claude -p "Use marketing-agent to draft today's Zinga social post(s) for Facebook Page + Instagram, in voice.md's voice. Pull from the campaign's content calendar and assets. Write each as a post draft in runs/$(date +%F)-marketing/ (headers: platform, image_url, link; then the caption). Draft only — never publish. No invented numbers, no claimed volume." --allowedTools "Read,Grep,Glob,Write,Edit" --permission-mode acceptEdits --output-format json --max-turns 20 --max-budget-usd 4.00 >> "runs/$(date +%F)-marketing.json"

parameters.text:
=social-post drafts ready. turns={{$json["num_turns"]}}. Posts staged in runs/, NOT published. Review, then publish manually with approval:
  python3 tools/social_publish.py --run runs/<date>-marketing --publish
